assets.title: Ovoko HUJ1820, 02B300044QX / CCY gearbox
assets.creator_or_supplier: AJM AUTO / Jaroslaw Paplewski, listing hosted by Ovoko
assets.data: Four product photographs inspected in browser, including both sides and clutch face
assets.identity: Listing reports 1995, 1896 cc diesel, manual FWD, CCY. User's 2001 gearbox code remains unknown.
assets.used_for: Original estimated CAD: irregular flange bosses, drafted casing, local webs/split flange, dark pressed end cover, tapered differential housing and radial output webs. User's supplied side photo additionally informs the missing ribbed output-shaft extension, end bearing collar/ear and relocated right CV flange. Extension dimensions derive from the provisional support/axle layout, not a scaled drawing.
assets.not_recovered: Metric scale, hidden surfaces, exact mounting holes, case split position, internal shaft locations or dimensional tolerances
assets.rights_status: No photo or scan redistributed. Site reserves rights; contact supplier/Ovoko before using their images or requesting scan assets for publication.

assets.title: AS-PL S0005 starter, Bosch replacement
assets.data: Manufacturer specification and gallery; front and side photographs visually inspected
assets.used_for: Original candidate-informed CAD: motor behind mounting flange, forward drive nose/window and parked pinion beside flywheel. Shared installed-coordinate geometry defines bellhousing relief. Nominal 235 mm length adopted as a provisional envelope, not identification of the installed starter. Flange outline, nose, motor/solenoid sizes and installation position remain estimates.
assets.identity: S0005-style candidate, NOT a confirmed match to the user's van; mounting-hole layout and installation dimensions unverified.
assets.rights_status: No asset embedded. Manufacturer contact info@as-pl.com for CAD and reuse enquiry.
